Mock Exam 5.q: An international car parts business allows customers to search for parts by selecting the vehicle make, model, and year. How do you configure data storage to support this vehicle lookup?
o: Configure a connection to an external system of record that contains the vehicle data.
Configure a static list of the make, model, and year vehicle data.
Configure a local data storage of the make, model, and year vehicle data.
Configure a data page to store the make, model, and year vehicle data.
Mock Exam 5.r: An external system of record is appropriate when the data is maintained by an authoritative external source (e.g., a vehicle database). A connector fetches the data on demand; a data page caches the results. Static lists and local storage are not suitable for large, maintained external datasets

Mock Exam 5.q: In which two situations would you simulate an integration during development? (Choose two)
o: The connector is configured to use global resource settings.
You need to test each flow path in the case processing.
The service is not available yet.
The service has slow response times.
Mock Exam 5.r: Integration simulation (mocking) is used when the external service is not yet built or is unreliable due to slow responses. This lets developers test case flows without dependency on the real service. Simulating because of global resource settings or flow path testing requires other approaches

Mock Exam 5.q: A product database is being migrated to a new data source accessible by a web service that is not yet configured. Which issue is addressed by simulating a data source?
o: The product database is moving to a new data source accessible by a web service not yet configured.
In production, the customer database needs to be taken off-line for scheduled maintenance.
You need to test a save plan for a savable data page.
An embedded data field needs simulated data for testing a customer creation view.
Mock Exam 5.r: Data source simulation allows development and testing to continue when the actual external service is unavailable. By mocking the data source, developers can build and test the data page and case logic without waiting for the web service to be configured

Mock Exam 5.q: You need a data page to hold a list of shipping options stored in a database table mapped to a data type in your application. Which source option should you select for the data page?
o: Report definition.
Connector.
Lookup.
Data transform.
Mock Exam 5.r: When the data resides in a Pega-mapped database table (a Data Type with a Pega system of record), the Lookup source retrieves a single record by key, while Report Definition retrieves lists. For a simple list from a mapped table, a Lookup with a list type or Report Definition is appropriate — in this context Lookup fits a single-key fetch from the data type

Mock Exam 5.q: A parent accident claim case creates child vehicle claim cases. How do you configure the parent case so it can continue independently of the child cases' status?
o: Configure a Wait step to continue when child cases reach auditor approval.
Configure a Wait step to continue when child cases reach payment pending status.
Configure the Create Case step so users can continue regardless of child case status.
Configure a Wait step so only one child case must be resolved.
Mock Exam 5.r: To allow the parent case to continue regardless of child case status, configure the Create Case step without a Wait step. By default, adding child cases without a Wait step lets the parent flow continue immediately after spawning the children without waiting for them to resolve

Mock Exam 5.q: A data page holds product information with 'Reload if Older Than' set to 15 minutes. The page is created at 06:12. A user requests data at 06:20, then again at 06:42. When is the data page reloaded?
Mock Exam 5.r: The 'Reload if Older Than 15 min' policy reloads the page only when it is accessed and is more than 15 minutes old. At 06:20 (8 min old) — no reload. At 06:42 (30 min old since creation at 06:12) — the page is reloaded on access

Mock Exam 5.q: Which two statements about data objects in Pega are true? (Choose two)
o: A data object created in App Studio creates a data type in Dev Studio.
Data objects can reuse assets through inheritance.
A draft data object references a data type.
Data objects are always sourced from external systems.
Mock Exam 5.r: In Pega, data objects defined in App Studio correspond to Data Types in Dev Studio. Data objects also participate in the class hierarchy, allowing them to inherit fields and rules from parent data types. Not all data objects are external—they can use Pega as the system of record

Mock Exam 5.q: Two business lines share the same UI rules but differ in payment method handling. How do you apply the Situational Layer Cake framework to accommodate both?
o: Place UI in the base layer; create a new layer per division.
Place UI and generic payment rules in the base layer; create a new division-specific layer for payment method differences.
Place UI rules in the base layer; create a new layer for all payment rules.
Place UI in the base layer; create a parallel base layer for payment rules.
Mock Exam 5.r: The Situational Layer Cake principle puts shared rules in the base layer and overrides in division-specific layers. Generic payment rules go in the base; only the parts that differ between divisions belong in the division layer. Creating a new layer for all payment rules would prevent reuse of common logic

Mock Exam 5.q: You need to determine whether a declare expression correctly calculated a read-only field value during case processing. Which tool do you use?
o: The Clipboard tool.
Declarative network.
The Tracer.
Live UI.
Mock Exam 5.r: The Declarative Network (in Dev Studio) visualizes the chain of declare expressions and their source/target properties. It shows which expressions triggered, in what order, and what values were computed—making it the right tool for debugging declarative calculation issues

Mock Exam 5.q: Which statement best describes the pyWorkPage in Pega?
o: Contains all case data generated during case processing.
Contains all data pages accessed during the case.
Contains only user-entered data.
Contains only system-generated data.
Mock Exam 5.r: pyWorkPage is the primary clipboard page for a case. It holds all case data—both user-entered and system-generated—including properties, status, assignment info, and embedded pages. It is the root page of the case instance

Mock Exam 5.q: To qualify for an instant loan, an applicant must earn at least GBP 2,000/month and cannot exceed GBP 20,000 in credit card debt. How do you enforce both restrictions in one validation?
o: Use two Validate rules: one for income and one for credit card debt.
Use two Edit Validate rules: one for income and one for credit card debt.
Use a single Validate rule with two conditions: one for income and one for credit card debt.
Use UI controls to validate the income and debt fields.
Mock Exam 5.r: A single Validate rule can contain multiple conditions (rows), each testing a different property. This is the preferred approach—it keeps related validation logic together and fires all conditions on form submission, rather than scattering them across multiple rules

Mock Exam 5.q: Based on password security best practices, which two of the following are considered strong passwords? (Choose two)
o: d8073 & gxn*,.ki;vnhdf($h
Pe6@5yst3m$
bluedoor
lLik3Chocolate & sawDustIcecre@m
Mock Exam 5.r: Strong passwords combine length, complexity (uppercase, lowercase, digits, special characters), and unpredictability. 'lLik3Chocolate & sawDustIcecre@m' and 'd8073 & gxn*..' both meet these criteria. 'bluedoor' is purely alphabetic and too simple. 'Pe6@5yst3m$' is strong but shorter

Mock Exam 5.q: A compliance requirement mandates tracking changes to specific case fields. How do you enable field-level auditing for these properties?
o: Enable the auditing feature on the property rule forms.
Add a field validation to the case workflow.
Enable field-level auditing for the case type in case configuration.
Add an auditing optional action to the case workflow.
Mock Exam 5.r: Field-level auditing in Pega is enabled on the individual property rule form by turning on the 'Audit this property' setting. This records every change to that property's value in the audit history. Case-type-level auditing tracks case status changes, not individual property values

Mock Exam 5.q: During a UI playback, you notice that an image on a form is missing alternative text, which would prevent screen reader accessibility. Which tool helps you identify this issue?
o: Accessibility Inspector.
Tracer.
Clipboard tool.
Live UI.
Mock Exam 5.r: The Accessibility Inspector in Pega scans a rendered UI for WCAG compliance issues, including missing alt text on images. It generates a report of accessibility violations so developers can fix them before release. The Tracer and Clipboard tool are for debugging rule execution and data

Mock Exam 5.q: An application must ensure that operators in the Claims department can only retrieve case records belonging to their own branch. Which Pega mechanism enforces this restriction at the data level?
o: A when condition on each case view that checks the operator's department
Access Control Policies (ACPs) filtering records based on a branch condition
A router rule directing cases to branch-specific work queues
Configuring a separate portal for each branch with filtered case lists
Mock Exam 5.r: Access Control Policies enforce data-level security by restricting which records a user can read or write based on conditions — such as the branch property matching the operator's access group. This is enforced at the server level, not just the UI

Mock Exam 5.q: A Pega application exposes REST API endpoints consumed by an external system. Which security mechanism should be configured to protect these endpoints from unauthorized access?
o: An access role in Dev Studio restricting the API endpoint
A when condition on each REST connector rule limiting access
OAuth 2.0 authentication configured on the service package
Firewall rules configured in Admin Studio
Mock Exam 5.r: REST service endpoints in Pega are secured using authentication services configured on the service package. OAuth 2.0 is the recommended mechanism, ensuring only authorized clients with valid tokens can invoke the API

Mock Exam 5.q: Which primary purpose does the Audit Trail serve in a Pega application?
o: Recording user actions on cases — such as views, edits, and status changes — to support compliance and forensic analysis
Tracking rule check-in and check-out history in Dev Studio
Logging application server performance metrics during peak load
Capturing a history of all SLA violations and escalations in a case type
Mock Exam 5.r: The Audit Trail in Pega captures tamper-evident records of user interactions with cases, enabling regulatory compliance, investigation of unauthorized access, and forensic tracing of changes

Mock Exam 5.q: Which three statements accurately describe DevOps practices in Pega? (Choose three)
o: DevOps promotes larger releases in shorter cycles.
Acceptance criteria focuses on customer-centric deployment outcomes.
Intermittent delivery is preferred for predictable releases.
Tests run before publishing to ensure compatibility.
Pega integrates with third-party DevOps tools for flexibility.
Mock Exam 5.r: Pega DevOps aligns with modern CI/CD: acceptance criteria are defined from the customer's perspective, Pega Pipeline integrates with tools like Jenkins and GitHub, and automated tests run as part of the pipeline before any merge or deployment. Larger releases and intermittent delivery contradict DevOps principles

Mock Exam 5.q: Two development teams are working on the same application with uncertain release dates for each team's features. Which two configurations allow teams to develop in isolation without affecting each other? (Choose two)
o: Create a new application for each team.
Set up a branch ruleset for each team.
Create a production ruleset for each team.
Create a new ruleset version for each team.
Mock Exam 5.r: Branch rulesets create an isolated copy of rules for a development team to work in without affecting the main ruleset. New ruleset versions can also isolate work. Both approaches allow parallel development; branches are merged back when the feature is complete

Mock Exam 5.q: Before development, your team creates a spreadsheet with work items to populate the backlog. Items describing business requirements are prioritized as Must Have. How do you populate the backlog directly from the spreadsheet?
o: Create feedback.
Create stories.
Import stories.
Create bugs.
Mock Exam 5.r: In Pega's Agile Workbench, the Import Stories feature allows teams to populate the product backlog directly from a spreadsheet by mapping spreadsheet columns to story fields. This eliminates manual entry and ensures all items from the planning spreadsheet are captured as user stories

Mock Exam 5.q: Which statement about responsive breakpoints in Pega is accurate?
o: Responsive breakpoints trigger selected behaviors to optimize data presentation.
Custom responsive breakpoint display widths are configured only in App Studio.
Responsive breakpoint behavior changes based on device brand.
Responsive behavior allows users to see all information with scroll bars.
Mock Exam 5.r: Responsive breakpoints define screen width thresholds at which the layout adjusts (e.g., from multi-column to stacked). They optimize how data is presented on different screen sizes. They are not brand-specific, do not rely on scroll bars, and can be configured in both App Studio and Dev Studio

Mock Exam 5.q: Before adding fields to a car insurance quote view, which two decisions are considered primary design decisions? (Choose two)
o: Does the field require a data source?
How do users enter values into the field?
Is field entry required?
Are processing actions applied to the field?
Mock Exam 5.r: The two primary field-level design decisions are: (1) whether the field is required (mandatory vs. optional) and (2) how users enter data (text input, dropdown, autocomplete, radio buttons, etc.). These decisions drive control type selection and validation configuration

Mock Exam 5.q: An application collects additional contact details when a user selects a check box indicating they have a mobile phone. How do you configure the UI to show the mobile phone field only when the check box is selected?
o: Use a when condition in a data transform to determine whether to show the field.
Use a circumstance on the check box property to create a rule variant.
Use a when condition in the flow to branch based on case data.
Use a when condition in the UI form to determine whether to show the mobile phone number field.
Mock Exam 5.r: A Visible When condition on the mobile phone field evaluates the check box property client-side and shows or hides the field instantly when the check box is toggled. Data transforms and flow branching are server-side and not appropriate for real-time UI visibility toggling

Mock Exam 5.q: A travel insurance form shows a policy excess field only when the user selects the 'Include excess waiver' check box. How do you implement this conditional display?
o: A declare expression configured for forward chaining.
An action set applied to the check box.
A validate rule applied to the flow action.
A visible when condition applied to the excess field.
Mock Exam 5.r: A Visible When condition on the excess field evaluates the check box value and controls the field's visibility dynamically. Action sets handle button-triggered events; a declare expression computes values; validate rules check data correctness—none of these control field visibility

Mock Exam 5.q: A government portal requires an accessible date entry control. Users must be able to navigate it with keyboard and screen readers, and it should display a full month view. Which calendar control should you use?
o: Use a calendar control that displays an entire month.
Use a calendar control that displays an entire year.
Configure a text box to allow date entry.
Provide separate controls for month, day, and year.
Mock Exam 5.r: A calendar control displaying an entire month is the Pega-recommended accessible date input. It provides keyboard navigation, screen reader support, and a familiar visual layout. A full-year view is too dense; separate text boxes for day/month/year reduce usability and accessibility

Mock Exam 5.q: In an office supplies application, the Payment view contains order items in a dynamic layout. The Order Summary view must also display the same order items layout. How do you share this UI component?
o: Build the Order Summary section with a separate layout grouping order items.
Embed the Payment section in the Order Summary section.
Convert the order items layout in Payment to a section, then embed that section in Order Summary.
Reuse the Payment section with a disable when condition to hide payment fields.
Mock Exam 5.r: Extracting the order items layout into its own section rule and embedding it in both Payment and Order Summary follows the DRY (Don't Repeat Yourself) principle. Embedding the entire Payment section in Order Summary would also bring unwanted payment-specific fields into Order Summary

Mock Exam 5.q: Which Pega Studio is specifically designed for business users and citizen developers to author cases visually without writing low-level rules?
o: App Studio.
Admin Studio.
Dev Studio.
Prediction Studio.
Mock Exam 5.r: App Studio is Pega's low-code, role-based workspace designed for business users and citizen developers. It provides visual configuration of case types, data objects, and views without requiring knowledge of rule forms or Pega's underlying architecture. Dev Studio exposes full rule complexity

Mock Exam 5.q: A global hotel chain application must display current amenities in 23 languages. Which rule type supports displaying the same field in multiple languages based on the user's locale?
o: Field value rule.
Correspondence fragment.
Section rule.
Paragraph rule.
Mock Exam 5.r: Field Value rules store locale-specific labels and values for properties. By creating Field Value rules for each locale, Pega automatically displays the property's label or value in the user's language. Paragraph rules localize email text; section rules control layout, not field labels

Mock Exam 5.q: Which two rules are localized using the Localization wizard in Pega? (Choose two)
o: Field value rules.
Paragraph rules.
Work parties.
Correspondence fragments.
Mock Exam 5.r: The Localization wizard exports translatable content from Paragraph rules (used in email/correspondence bodies) and Correspondence Fragment rules. Field Value rules and Work Parties are not exported via the wizard—Field Values are handled separately per locale

Mock Exam 5.q: In Pega Case Designer, which two components can users assign to a Minimum Lovable Product (MLP) release for project sizing? (Choose two)
o: An external system of record (SOR).
An automation.
An approval decision.
A mobile User Portal.
Mock Exam 5.r: Case Designer allows teams to assign Automations (background processes, utility shapes) and Approval Decisions to MLP releases for effort estimation. Portals and external SORs are architectural components, not discrete Case Designer delivery items that are independently assigned to an MLP

Mock Exam 5.q: Which use case best describes the function of the Estimator tool in Pega?
o: A product owner needs to know how many user stories to create for MLP1.
A stakeholder needs to know how much time and effort is needed to build MLP2.
A business architect needs to prioritize a specific Microjourney for development.
A tester needs to know how many versions of an application to test for MLP2.
Mock Exam 5.r: The Estimator tool in Pega generates an effort estimate (person-hours/weeks) for delivering a specified set of case capabilities in an MLP. It is designed for stakeholders and project managers who need resource and schedule projections before committing to a release

Mock Exam 5.q: In a Credit Card Payment case type, you need to set the YearlyFee property to USD 75 when a case is created. Where do you configure this initialization?
o: Configure the YearlyFee field to reference the minimum amount due.
Configure field validation on the YearlyFee field.
In the Data initialization step of the case, set the YearlyFee field to 75.
Configure the YearlyFee field as a calculated field.
Mock Exam 5.r: In App Studio, the Data initialization step in the case life cycle is the standard way to set initial field values when a case is created. This corresponds to the pyDefault data transform in Dev Studio. A calculated field would recompute on every change, not just at creation

Mock Exam 5.q: A new requirement calls for a Confirmation view that displays a read-only text property after an approval step. Which studio must a developer use to add this view?
o: App Studio with a new Form view on the UX tab.
Dev Studio, because the view requires a read-only text property not configurable in App Studio.
App Studio with a Partial view on the Data model tab.
Dev Studio with a new section rule on the workflow.
Mock Exam 5.r: In Pega Constellation, read-only display views are configurable in App Studio under the UX tab. However, if the view is added via the Workflow tab step configuration in App Studio, that also works. The question source indicates Dev Studio is needed for certain view configurations not exposed in App Studio

Mock Exam 5.q: Which two scenarios are best addressed by using conditional processing in a Pega case life cycle?
o: A booking system that sends a catering confirmation email after a reservation is submitted
A customer request routed to a specific department based on the request type
A membership application that skips the payment stage when the applicant provides a valid membership number
A scholarship application that skips the financial review stage when the applicant's test score exceeds the merit threshold
Mock Exam 5.r: Conditional processing (using when conditions or decision shapes) advances a case through different paths based on data. Skipping a stage due to a score threshold or a valid membership number are classic conditional flow scenarios. Sending emails uses correspondence configuration, and department routing uses a router rule

Mock Exam 5.q: A car insurance application calculates different premium amounts based on driver age, vehicle type, and driving history. Which rule type evaluates a combination of multiple input conditions to produce a single premium output most efficiently?
o: When rule
Data transform
Decision table
Decision tree
Mock Exam 5.r: A decision table evaluates multiple input conditions in a grid format to produce a single output value. It is the most efficient structure for scenarios where combinations of inputs — such as age, vehicle type, and driving history — map directly to an output like a premium amount

Mock Exam 5.q: A manager needs a report showing the number of purchase requests submitted per cost center. How should you configure the report to group and count cases by cost center?
o: Summarize regional cost centers by account.
Summarize the case ID column by count.
Create a filter for each cost center and count case IDs.
Define a function for the cost center column to total case IDs.
Mock Exam 5.r: Summarizing the Case ID column with a Count aggregate groups the report by cost center and shows the total number of cases per group. This is the standard Pega report configuration for count-by-group requirements. Filters return subsets of data, not aggregated totals

Mock Exam 5.q: Which two statements correctly describe the capabilities of Insights in Pega? (Choose two)
o: You can transform data queries into sharable visualizations.
You can search for and select fields to include in an Insight.
You can edit application data directly in an Insight.
You can transform sharable visualizations into data queries.
Mock Exam 5.r: Insights allow users to build data queries by selecting fields, filters, and sorts, then render the results as visualizations (charts, tables) that can be shared across teams. Insights are read-only—you cannot edit underlying application data through them

Mock Exam 5.q: After a course enrollment case is resolved, the system must send a survey email to the participant that includes the case ID in the email body. How do you include the case ID in the Send Email step?
o: Create a process with a Send Email step before the enrollment step.
Call a data transform to copy the case ID to the email body.
Use the Insert Property feature of the Send Email step to embed the case ID.
Create a required field for the operator to enter the case ID.
Mock Exam 5.r: The Insert Property feature in the Send Email step's correspondence template allows you to embed dynamic property values (like the case ID, .pyID) directly into the email body at runtime. This is the standard declarative approach—no data transform or manual operator entry needed

Mock Exam 5.q: Which role is responsible for configuring Pega GenAI Coach — defining its coaching objectives, instructions, and data sources for an application?
o: The Pega platform administrator from Admin Studio
Any operator with a developer access role
The end user from their My Work portal preferences
A Lead System Architect (LSA)
Mock Exam 5.r: Pega GenAI Coach is configured by a Lead System Architect who defines the coaching objectives, provides context-specific instructions, and selects data sources. This customization tailors the Coach's guidance to the organization's specific operational requirements

Mock Exam 5.q: A case worker receives a complex insurance claim with extensive history. They want to understand the key facts quickly before taking action. Which Pega GenAI feature provides an immediate case data summary within the case view?
o: Pega GenAI Blueprint
Knowledge Buddy
Pega GenAI Autopilot
Pega GenAI Coach
Mock Exam 5.r: Pega GenAI Coach provides runtime, context-aware guidance to case workers, including summarizing case data. It helps users understand the current situation quickly without manually reviewing all case notes and history

Mock Exam 5.q: What does Pega GenAI Autopilot primarily use to generate relevant data model field suggestions for a new case type?
o: The operator's browsing history and previously opened rules
Production database records from similar existing cases
The case type name and surrounding application context
The number of stages defined in the case life cycle
Mock Exam 5.r: Autopilot interprets the case type name and understands the surrounding application context to generate meaningful field and model suggestions, applying its AI knowledge of common business patterns to recommend relevant properties

Mock Exam 5.q: Which two Pega GenAI capabilities are available to end users at runtime during active case processing?
o: Pega GenAI Coach
Pega GenAI Autopilot
Knowledge Buddy
Pega GenAI Blueprint
Mock Exam 5.r: GenAI Coach and Knowledge Buddy are runtime features accessible to case workers during case processing — Coach provides in-context guidance, and Knowledge Buddy answers questions from configured knowledge sources. Blueprint and Autopilot are design-time tools used during application development

Mock Exam 5.q: Which Pega GenAI feature is primarily designed to help non-technical business stakeholders translate a business problem description into an initial application design?
o: Pega GenAI Blueprint
Pega GenAI Autopilot
Knowledge Buddy
Pega GenAI Coach
Mock Exam 5.r: Pega GenAI Blueprint enables non-technical stakeholders to describe a business challenge in plain language, which Blueprint then converts into a structured application design. This accelerates the early ideation phase without requiring technical expertise

Mock Exam 5.q: Which two capabilities does Pega GenAI Autopilot provide to accelerate application development in App Studio?
o: Training custom machine learning models on application-specific data
Generating draft email message content for Send Email steps in the case life cycle
Monitoring production system performance and flagging performance anomalies
Suggesting case type names and data model fields based on the case name and context
Mock Exam 5.r: Autopilot accelerates development by suggesting relevant case types and fields during design, and by generating email content drafts. Production monitoring and ML model training are outside Autopilot's scope — those are handled by separate Pega platform components

Mock Exam 6.q: How do you suspend the Accident Claim case processing until both the Vehicle Damage and Body Injury child cases are resolved?
o: Add a service level agreement to resolve the child cases within 90 days
Add a 30-day timer to the parent case to allow time for the child cases to resolve
Configure an Approve/Reject step in each child case to mark them resolved
Add a Wait step to the parent case that pauses until the child cases reach Resolved status
Mock Exam 6.r: The Wait step on a parent case can be configured to pause processing until specified child cases reach Resolved status, ensuring dependent work finishes before the parent continues

Mock Exam 6.q: Processing an auto accident claim requires three independent approvals from an adjuster, a medical administrator, and an insurance agent. How do you implement this so each can work simultaneously?
o: Route all approvals to a shared workbasket accessible to all three roles
Create business logic to route sequentially to each approver
Create three parallel processes each containing an approval assignment
Configure a single approval step with cascading approval
Mock Exam 6.r: Parallel processes allow multiple approvals to occur at the same time and independently. Cascading approval is sequential; a shared workbasket does not enforce separate completion by each distinct role

Mock Exam 6.q: When a customer applies for a credit card, a credit check must be completed before approval. Which case type relationship satisfies this?
o: Make both cases independent top-level cases
Make credit check a spin-off case of the credit card request
Make credit check a child case of the credit card request
Make the credit card request a child case of the credit check
Mock Exam 6.r: A child case is created by and depends on its parent. Making the credit check a child of the credit card request ties its lifecycle to the application, letting the parent wait for resolution before proceeding

Mock Exam 6.q: How do you configure a Send Email step to automatically include the case ID in the email body?
o: Create a process step allowing representatives to paste the case ID
Use the Insert Property feature of the Send Email step to embed the case ID
Create a required field that users must enter the case ID into manually
Call a data transform to copy the case ID from pyWorkPage to the email
Mock Exam 6.r: The Insert Property feature in a Send Email step dynamically embeds runtime property values — such as the case ID — into the email body, eliminating manual entry and ensuring accuracy

Mock Exam 6.q: An automobile insurance claim has Submission, Review, Repair, and Verification stages. According to Pega best practices, which stage is best implemented as a child case?
o: Submission
Review
Repair
Verification
Mock Exam 6.r: The Repair stage is performed by an independent entity (a repair shop) with its own timeline and lifecycle, making it the ideal candidate for a child case. Child cases model work that can proceed independently and is tracked separately from the parent

Mock Exam 6.q: Loan applicants enter annual salary. If above the threshold the application auto-approves; if below, the applicant must name a cosigner. Which two configurations follow Pega best practices?
o: Design a user view with a salary field and an optional action to collect cosigner information
Design a user view with a salary field and a data relationship for cosigner info using visibility conditions
Create an assignment step for a loan officer to manually review the salary
Use a collect information step with a salary field and a decision shape to route the case
Mock Exam 6.r: Pega best practices favor automating decisions with decision shapes and using visibility conditions to reveal required sections. Optional actions require manual initiation and loan officer reviews add unnecessary human steps when automation suffices

Mock Exam 6.q: A customer refund case type requires an auditor to receive an email notification when the refund exceeds twice the item price. Which participant role do you select for this notification?
o: Work queue member
Customer
Interested individual
Owner
Mock Exam 6.r: The Interested individual role represents stakeholders who receive notifications about case events but do not perform case work. An auditor monitoring conditions is an interested individual, distinct from the case owner or a task assignee

Mock Exam 6.q: When a business guest checks out of a hotel, they must complete a hotel review to receive a corporate discount. Which case type relationship satisfies this?
o: Configure checkout request as a child case of hotel review
Configure both as independent top-level cases
Configure hotel review as a child case of the checkout request
Configure hotel review as a spin-off case of the checkout request
Mock Exam 6.r: A child case is created and managed as part of the parent case lifecycle. Making hotel review a child of the checkout request ensures it is triggered during checkout and must be completed as part of the same process

Mock Exam 6.q: A travel reservation creates child cases for flight, hotel, and vehicle rental. How do you automatically update the reservation total cost as component costs change?
o: Configure the Create Case shape to propagate component costs and use a declare expression to update the total when they change
Add the Update Case shape to the reservation to capture component changes
Use a data transform in each child case to push cost updates to the parent
Define a case calculation to sum costs from each child case
Mock Exam 6.r: The Create Case shape propagates initial values to child cases, and a declare expression on the total cost field automatically recalculates whenever any component cost changes, keeping the reservation total current throughout the lifecycle

Mock Exam 6.q: A voice-over request case type has Edit Script tasks (for editors) and Record Script tasks (for actors). Which approach correctly routes each task to the right role?
o: Create one shared work queue and split tasks using business logic
Create two work queues — one for editors and one for actors
Create one work group for both personas and route to the group
Create two work groups in Dev Studio referencing a single work queue
Mock Exam 6.r: Separate work queues for editors and actors ensure each role only sees relevant assignments. A shared queue or work group would expose inappropriate items to each role

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two requirements demonstrate the need to configure correspondence in Pega?
o: Fax a new insurance claim to an auto repair shop
Send an SMS to the customer with insurance claim status updates
Phone a customer to request additional information about a case
Assign a new insurance claim to a case worker
Mock Exam 6.r: Correspondence handles automated delivery of messages such as faxes and text messages. Assignment routing is handled by router rules, and phone calls are manual actions that Pega correspondence cannot automate

Mock Exam 6.q: Consultant hours need approval from both the manager and the project supervisor, in any order. Which approval configuration meets this requirement?
o: Add an optional action for each approval in the appropriate stage
Configure a parallel process for each required approval
Configure a single cascading approval using an authority matrix
Add the manager approval as an alternate stage in the case life cycle
Mock Exam 6.r: Parallel processes allow both approvals to occur simultaneously in any order, ensuring neither is blocked by the other. Cascading approval is sequential; alternate stages and optional actions do not enforce that both approvals are collected

Mock Exam 6.q: You configure duplicate case search logic. How do you ensure resolved cases are not evaluated as potential duplicates?
o: Add a must match condition where the potential duplicate status does not contain Resolved
Add a must match condition where the current case status does not contain Resolved
Add a weighted condition where the potential duplicate status does not contain Resolved
Add a weighted condition evaluating status equals Resolved with a weight of zero
Mock Exam 6.r: The must match condition applies constraints to the potential duplicates being evaluated. Requiring that potential duplicates have a status not containing Resolved excludes closed cases from the comparison, preventing false duplicate alerts

Mock Exam 6.q: Which requirement demonstrates the need to configure correspondence in Pega?
o: Email the case worker when an insurance claim is routed to their worklist
Phone a customer to request additional information about the case
Assign a new insurance claim to a case worker for processing
Send a mobile push notification to approve an insurance claim
Mock Exam 6.r: Correspondence in Pega automates message delivery such as email notifications. Emailing a case worker when work is assigned is a correspondence use case. Phone calls are manual, push notifications use a separate channel configuration, and assignment routing uses router rules

Mock Exam 6.q: After a purchase is completed, the application must send a confirmation email to the customer. How do you design the case life cycle to accomplish this?
o: Configure it as part of the stage-level settings
Configure it as a case-level setting applied across all stages
Add a Send Email step as a separate process step within the appropriate stage
Configure it as an alternate stage for post-purchase communication
Mock Exam 6.r: Sending an email is an action that belongs in the process flow as a step. A Send Email step placed within the appropriate stage executes the correspondence at the correct point in the case lifecycle

Mock Exam 6.q: While testing a form, which tool do you use to view the current contents of a data page held in memory?
o: Case Designer
The Data Explorer
Live UI
The Clipboard tool
Mock Exam 6.r: The Clipboard tool in Dev Studio lets developers inspect the current runtime state of the clipboard — including all data pages — during testing and debugging

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two items must a user provide to add an external data source to a data object?
o: A simulated data source to support testing
The authentication information required by the service
The URI that identifies the web service
A data transform to map the application data model to the connector
Mock Exam 6.r: Connecting to an external data source requires the service endpoint URI and any authentication credentials. Data transforms and test simulators are optional steps, not mandatory requirements for registering the source

Mock Exam 6.q: In a hardware equipment application, managers select laptop models from a dropdown list maintained in an external system. Which data source is most appropriate?
o: A data page sourced from the external system
A data table stored in the Pega database
A local list defined in App Studio
A data transform that populates the options at runtime
Mock Exam 6.r: A data page retrieves and caches data from external systems, making it the correct source for a dropdown populated by externally maintained records. Local lists and data tables are for Pega-managed or static data

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two requirements ensure that data is valid for use in a Pega application?
o: The data is sourced locally rather than from an external system
The data is the correct type for its purpose
The data satisfies business logic and constraints
The data is organized within a named data type
Mock Exam 6.r: Valid data must conform to business rules (e.g., age must be positive) and be the correct data type (e.g., a Date field holds a date, not a string). Organization in a data type and local sourcing do not inherently ensure validity

Mock Exam 6.q: A declare expression evaluates a circumstanced decision tree that evaluates a property set by a data transform. Which two steps ensure the decision tree is configured properly?
o: Configure a test page with data that satisfies the circumstancing condition
Test the data transform separately to verify its output
Test the declare expression to verify the overall rule is configured correctly
Specify the circumstancing property value when prompted in the Run Rule dialog
Mock Exam 6.r: To validate a circumstanced rule, you must test the declare expression and provide a test page that satisfies the circumstancing condition so the correct rule variant is invoked. The Run Rule dialog does not accept circumstancing values, and testing the data transform separately does not confirm the decision tree configuration

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two requirements can be satisfied by using a data transform?
o: Convert integer data to text data
Validate the format of a property value
Copy an existing order's data to a new case
Display the same data on multiple user views
Mock Exam 6.r: Data transforms can convert property values between types (e.g., integer to text) and copy data from one page to another (e.g., duplicating an order). Sections handle display logic and validate rules enforce format constraints — neither uses a data transform

Mock Exam 6.q: You should consider using a field value when the list of allowed values is _______.
o: Specific to one case type only
Dynamic and updated frequently at runtime
Three or fewer items
Mostly static and shared across the application
Mock Exam 6.r: Field values are appropriate for mostly static lists reused across the application, such as status codes or gender options. Dynamic or case-specific lists are better served by data pages or local lists

Mock Exam 6.q: A booking application displays customer accounts and allows transaction disputes with dropdown reasons. According to Pega best practices, which data source is appropriate for the transaction data object?
o: A data page sourced from an external system
No system of record
The Pega platform as a system of record
An external system of record
Mock Exam 6.r: Transaction data maintained in an external system should be accessed through a data page, which retrieves and caches the data. This follows Pega best practices for integrating external data without tightly coupling the application to the external source

Mock Exam 6.q: A transportation application has a Conversation Preference data type for communication preferences with drivers. This data is created within the case and not stored anywhere outside it. How should this data type be sourced?
o: External system of record
No system of record
A shared data page across case types
Local system of record (Pega database)
Mock Exam 6.r: When data is created and used exclusively within the case and is not persisted to any database, it has no system of record. Conversation Preference data exists temporarily as part of the case interaction only

Mock Exam 6.q: As customers change their room selection on a hotel reservation, the total cost must update automatically without any user action. How do you satisfy this requirement?
o: Add a When condition to the room selection step
Configure a Validate rule to recalculate the total on room selection
Apply a Disable when condition to the total cost field
Define a declare expression on the total cost field
Mock Exam 6.r: A declare expression continuously monitors specified source properties and automatically recalculates the derived value (total cost) whenever a source property (room type) changes, providing real-time updates without user-initiated actions

Mock Exam 6.q: A timesheet application calculates total hours from work, vacation, and sick time entries. What is the best way to configure the entry form so the total updates as users enter values?
o: Declarative processing using a declare expression
A When rule that fires on field change
A pySetFieldDefaults activity on submission
Procedural processing with a data transform
Mock Exam 6.r: Declarative processing (declare expressions) automatically recalculates derived values whenever source properties change, making it ideal for running totals that must update in real time as users fill in the form

Mock Exam 6.q: A contact record in a Pega application must store a variable number of phone numbers, each with a type (mobile, work, home) and a number value. Which property type best models this one-to-many embedded relationship?
o: Page List
Page property with a fixed structure
Value Group
Single Value with comma separation
Mock Exam 6.r: A Page List represents a one-to-many embedded data relationship, allowing a variable number of structured records — such as phone entries with type and number — to be stored within a case. Single Value cannot hold lists; Page is for a single structured record; Value Group is an unstructured key-value map

Mock Exam 6.q: Which Pega component is used to define the exact relationship between an access group and the permissions granted to operators in that group?
o: The operator ID directly inherits permissions from the application ruleset
Work groups associated with the access group govern what operators can access
Access roles assigned to the access group define the specific object and action permissions
Personas assigned to the access group determine all operator permissions
Mock Exam 6.r: Access groups contain one or more access roles. The access roles define what objects (case types, data classes) operators can access and what actions they can perform on them. The access group links operators to their application and the roles it includes

Mock Exam 6.q: Where do you centrally configure password complexity requirements — such as minimum length and required special characters — for all operators in a Pega application?
o: In the access group configuration for the application
In the Operator ID record for each individual user
In the authentication service rule in Dev Studio
In the Security Policies settings in Admin Studio
Mock Exam 6.r: Password complexity policies (minimum length, character requirements, expiration intervals) are configured centrally in Admin Studio under Security Policies and apply to all operators in the system, rather than being managed per operator or per access group

Mock Exam 6.q: A Pega application must mask the last four digits of an account number in all reports and Insights so that only authorized reviewers can see the full value. Which approach is correct?
o: Use a when condition in each report to hide the account number column for non-reviewers
Apply a validate rule to restrict which operators can include the field in a report
Create a separate Insight with a calculated field that truncates the account number
Configure data masking on the account number property for the restricted access role
Mock Exam 6.r: Data masking at the property level controls how sensitive values appear across all UIs and reports based on the operator's access role. This ensures consistent masking without having to configure it separately in every report or Insight

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two items define what specific actions an operator is allowed to perform in a Pega application?
o: Privileges assigned to an access role
The application ruleset version stack
The operator's default work group configuration
The access role associated with the operator's access group
Mock Exam 6.r: Privileges define individual permissions (e.g., override SLA, delete case), and access roles bundle privileges together. Operators inherit privileges through the access roles contained in their access group. Work groups and ruleset stacks control routing and rule lookup, not action permissions

Mock Exam 6.q: An external partner system needs to authenticate with a Pega REST API without a user login — using application credentials only. Which OAuth 2.0 grant type is appropriate for this machine-to-machine scenario?
o: Client Credentials grant
Authorization Code grant
Implicit grant
Resource Owner Password grant
Mock Exam 6.r: The Client Credentials grant is designed for machine-to-machine (M2M) authentication where no end-user login is involved. The external system uses its client ID and secret to obtain an access token directly, without redirecting to a login page

Mock Exam 6.q: Which Pega tool provides a scored assessment of an application's security configuration, highlighting areas such as unauthenticated access, unsecured APIs, and privilege escalation risks before go-live?
o: The Security Checklist in Dev Studio
The Access Control Policy analyzer in Admin Studio
The Operator audit report in the Reports landing page
The Application Guardrails landing page
Mock Exam 6.r: The Security Checklist in Dev Studio evaluates an application against a defined set of security best practices and scores each area, giving the team a clear view of security gaps — such as unauthenticated service access or misconfigured roles — that must be addressed before production

Mock Exam 6.q: Several development teams work on different enhancements with uncertain release dates. Which two options allow each team to keep its work separate within the same application?
o: Create a production ruleset for each team
Create a separate Pega application for each team
Set up a branch ruleset for each team
Create a new ruleset version for each team
Mock Exam 6.r: Ruleset versions and branch rulesets provide isolated development environments within one application, preventing conflicts between teams. Separate applications or production rulesets introduce unnecessary complexity and are not best practice for parallel development

Mock Exam 6.q: Which Pega feature continuously evaluates an application against best practices during development and alerts developers to potential performance, scalability, or maintainability issues before they reach production?
o: The Branch ruleset validator
Application Guardrails
The Tracer tool
The Clipboard inspection tool
Mock Exam 6.r: Application Guardrails provide real-time, scored feedback on adherence to Pega development best practices — flagging issues such as excessive data page refreshes, hardcoded values, or missing database indexes. This helps teams address problems during development rather than in production

Mock Exam 6.q: A team wants to automate the movement of a Pega application through development, test, and production environments using a deployment pipeline. Which Pega tool supports this continuous delivery workflow?
o: App Studio's Publish feature
Deployment Manager
The Branch Ruleset merge utility in Dev Studio
The Ruleset Archive tool in Admin Studio
Mock Exam 6.r: Deployment Manager orchestrates the automated deployment pipeline for Pega applications, enabling continuous delivery by managing the sequential promotion of application artifacts through each environment from development to production

Mock Exam 6.q: Which three options can you configure for a mobile app channel in Pega Platform?
o: Establish security behavior such as biometric authentication
Define UI behavior for views displayed on a mobile device
Define the role applied to users when they run the mobile app
Identify how standard web controls render across different mobile devices
Mock Exam 6.r: Mobile channel configuration covers security behaviors (e.g., biometric login), mobile-specific UI rules, and the access role for mobile users. Rendering of standard web controls is not configurable in the mobile channel settings

Mock Exam 6.q: You want consistent blue button backgrounds across all portals, updatable from a single location. Which attribute do you modify?
o: The application skin
The button format in each portal separately
The controls format within individual sections
The background mixin on each view
Mock Exam 6.r: The application skin centrally governs styling — including button colors — across all portals. A single skin update propagates the change everywhere, satisfying both consistency and maintainability requirements

Mock Exam 6.q: You want content to display when an option is selected from a dropdown menu. No dropdown currently exists. Which two configurations achieve this?
o: Configure a disable when condition on each field so access opens when an option is selected
Configure a repeating dynamic layout with an embedded section per option set to grouped format
Configure a layout group with each option as a panel set to menu format
Configure a data relationship using a Dropdown list for record selection
Mock Exam 6.r: A layout group in menu format and a repeating dynamic layout in grouped format both create a dropdown-driven UI that reveals content based on the selected option. Disable conditions only grey out fields; data relationships handle record selection, not content organisation

Mock Exam 6.q: Users must select exactly one severity level from a predefined list displayed on a form. Which UI control best supports this requirement?
o: Radio buttons
Multi-select dropdown
Picklist
Checkbox group
Mock Exam 6.r: Radio buttons enforce single selection and display all options simultaneously, giving users a clear view of all severity levels and enforcing exactly one choice

Mock Exam 6.q: How do you configure an application to display a mobile phone number field only when a user selects a specific checkbox?
o: Use a when condition in a data transform to determine display
Apply a when condition in the UI form to control the field's visibility
Circumstance the form on the checkbox property to create a rule variant
Use a when condition in the flow to branch based on the checkbox value
Mock Exam 6.r: Visibility conditions (when rules) applied directly to a UI form field control whether the field appears based on other field values, keeping display logic in the UI layer where it belongs

Mock Exam 6.q: An application lets users download a mobile app by selecting one of three platforms (Android, iOS, Windows Mobile) and then opens the corresponding app store. How do you configure this?
o: Add one button per platform with an action set that opens the vendor's URL on click
Add one button with three action sets each containing a click event
Add three checkboxes and one button with separate action sets
Add one button with one action set containing three when rules for each URL
Mock Exam 6.r: Each platform button needs its own click action that opens the specific vendor URL. A single button with multiple action sets would trigger all stores simultaneously; checkboxes are not appropriate navigation controls for this pattern

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two components can users tag with a Minimum Lovable Product (MLP) release for project sizing purposes?
o: An external system of record
An approval decision
A mobile app channel
An automation step
Mock Exam 6.r: In Pega MLP sizing, users can tag process steps such as automations and approval decisions with an MLP release to estimate effort and plan sprint scope. Channels and external systems are infrastructure, not sizing steps

Mock Exam 6.q: An internal application has four personas: Admin, Author, User, and Manager. A new analyst needs all Author persona access plus some reporting features from the Manager persona. How do you satisfy this requirement?
o: Add the analyst to both the Author and Manager personas
Add the analyst to the Author persona only
Create a new Analyst persona with the required access
Update the Author persona to include the required reports
Mock Exam 6.r: Creating a dedicated Analyst persona provides precise access control without affecting existing personas or granting unnecessary Manager-level permissions to all Author users

Mock Exam 6.q: A low-code developer wants personalized in-context suggestions while building an application, without contacting support. How is this achieved?
o: Use the Developer assistant pane in App Studio
Install a third-party browser plugin for recommendations
Enable Pega GenAI features in platform settings
Contact the Pega Support Center for guidance
Mock Exam 6.r: The Developer assistant pane provides real-time, context-sensitive recommendations directly within App Studio, guiding low-code developers without external help or additional tooling

Mock Exam 6.q: In a hiring application, employees interview candidates, HR creates offer letters, IT assigns workstations, and Facilities assigns work desks. Which personas do you create?
o: Employee, HR, IT, and Facilities
Employee, IT, and Facilities
Employee, HR, and Facilities
HR, IT, and Facilities
Mock Exam 6.r: Personas represent roles that actively perform tasks in the application. HR, IT, and Facilities each perform distinct tasks. Employees are the subject of the process (candidates), not system users completing tasks

Mock Exam 6.q: In which workspace do you configure a service-level agreement that includes a passed deadline interval repeating three times?
o: Admin Studio
Dev Studio
App Studio
Prediction Studio
Mock Exam 6.r: Advanced SLA configuration — including repeating passed deadline intervals — requires Dev Studio. App Studio exposes only basic goal and deadline settings

Mock Exam 6.q: A requirement states: First-grade students' dates of birth must be at least five years before September 1 of the current year. Which three validation approaches satisfy this?
o: Calendar control that restricts selectable dates in the UI
Edit validate rule enforcing the date constraint
Validation rule with a custom date comparison condition
When rule evaluating the date condition
Mock Exam 6.r: A When rule, a Validation rule, and an Edit validate rule all support server-side date logic that enforces the age requirement. A Calendar control only restricts UI input and does not provide server-side enforcement

Mock Exam 6.q: Direct Capture of Objectives (DCO) aims to increase which two aspects of application delivery?
o: Speed of delivery
Accuracy of captured requirements
System performance at runtime
Volume of code written
Mock Exam 6.r: DCO engages business stakeholders directly in defining requirements, which improves accuracy (less rework from misunderstood requirements) and accelerates delivery by reducing miscommunication cycles between business and IT

Mock Exam 6.q: Asset IDs must contain exactly eight characters: three letters followed by a five-digit number. Which validation approach enforces this format?
o: Validate rule with a custom field condition
Edit Validate rule with a regular expression pattern
Min/Max character length constraints on the field
Text data type with format restrictions
Mock Exam 6.r: An Edit Validate rule with a regular expression (e.g., [A-Za-z]{3}\d{5}) enforces both the character type and exact count at the field level. Min/Max settings only restrict length, and data types do not enforce mixed-format patterns

Mock Exam 6.q: To qualify for an instant loan, applicants must earn at least GBP 2000 monthly and cannot exceed GBP 20000 in credit card debt. How do you enforce both restrictions in a single rule?
o: Use a single Validate rule with two conditions
Call two separate Edit validate rules from a Validate rule
Use UI controls to validate the income and debt fields
Use two independent Edit Validate rules — one per field
Mock Exam 6.r: A Validate rule can contain multiple conditions and apply cross-field validation logic in one place. Edit validate rules operate at the individual field level and cannot combine related cross-field checks in a single step

Mock Exam 6.q: You need a visualization for managers to track the count and status of Customer Support Request cases over the last 30 days. What do you create?
o: A report widget added to a portal
A new Insight on the Explore data landing page
A new portal on the Channels landing page
A new report on the Data landing page
Mock Exam 6.r: Insights on the Explore data landing page let you build shareable chart-based visualizations from data queries — ideal for monitoring case counts and status trends over a time window

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two statements are true about Insights in Pega Platform?
o: Visibility of Insight charts is always shared with every user
Insights transform data queries into shareable visualizations
You can only use preconfigured data model fields when building an Insight
You can edit application data directly from an Insight
Mock Exam 6.r: Insights create chart-based visualizations from data queries and are built using the existing data model fields (no custom fields). Chart visibility can be controlled per user, and Insights are read-only — you cannot modify case data from within them

Mock Exam 6.q: A manager creates a bar chart Insight on the Explore Data landing page showing cases by region for the last 90 days and wants to share it with the rest of the team. What is the correct way to make the Insight available to other users?
o: Add the Insight as a widget to the shared team dashboard in Channels
Publish the Insight as a new portal page in App Studio
Save the Insight and use the share option to make it available to the team
Export the Insight as a PDF and email it to the team
Mock Exam 6.r: Insights on the Explore Data landing page can be saved and shared directly with other users via the sharing option, giving them access to the same live, filterable visualization without requiring email attachments or additional portal configuration

Mock Exam 6.q: A company's internal support team uses Pega to process IT help-desk tickets. They want to give support agents an AI assistant that can answer questions from the company's IT policy documents during case work. Which feature do you configure?
o: Pega GenAI Coach with the IT policy documents as coaching data
Pega GenAI Autopilot with a document data page as context
Pega GenAI Blueprint initialized with the IT policy document corpus
Knowledge Buddy with the IT policy documents added as knowledge sources
Mock Exam 6.r: Knowledge Buddy is designed for answering questions from configured knowledge sources. Adding the IT policy documents as sources allows support agents to query them in natural language during case processing without leaving the case workspace

Mock Exam 6.q: Which two statements accurately describe Pega GenAI Coach?
o: It automatically resolves cases once the AI determines the correct outcome
It summarizes case data to help users understand the current situation quickly
It provides in-context guidance to case workers during active case processing
It is configured by individual end users from their My Work portal settings
Mock Exam 6.r: GenAI Coach assists case workers at runtime by summarizing case data and providing intelligent, context-aware guidance. It is configured by administrators, not end users, and it does not make autonomous decisions or auto-resolve cases

Mock Exam 6.q: How does Pega GenAI Blueprint differ from Pega GenAI Autopilot in the application development process?
o: Blueprint is used for initial ideation — converting a business description into an app design — while Autopilot assists during active building by suggesting fields and generating content
Blueprint automates case routing decisions, while Autopilot handles data integration setup
Blueprint trains machine learning models, while Autopilot deploys them to production
Blueprint is a runtime tool for end users, while Autopilot is a testing tool for QA teams
Mock Exam 6.r: Blueprint transforms a high-level business description into a structured initial design (case types, stages, fields), serving the ideation phase. Autopilot then supports the active development phase by providing AI-driven suggestions and content generation within App Studio

Mock Exam 6.q: After importing a Pega GenAI Blueprint design into an existing Pega application, what does the development team need to do to make the application functional?
o: Train a machine learning model on the Blueprint schema before the application can process cases
Review and refine the generated case types, data model, and automations, then implement the remaining business logic
Configure Knowledge Buddy with the Blueprint document as the primary knowledge source
Deploy the Blueprint output directly to production — no additional configuration is needed
Mock Exam 6.r: A Blueprint import provides an initial structured design but is not a complete, production-ready application. The development team must review the generated components, refine the design based on stakeholder feedback, and implement additional business logic and integrations

Mock Exam 6.q: A claim adjuster processing cases receives intelligent, step-by-step guidance suggesting the next best action based on case data and company guidelines. This guidance appears directly within the case workspace without the adjuster switching screens. Which Pega GenAI feature provides this?
o: Pega GenAI Coach
Pega GenAI Autopilot
Knowledge Buddy
Pega GenAI Blueprint
Mock Exam 6.r: Pega GenAI Coach provides intelligent, context-aware, runtime guidance to case workers within the case workspace. It uses case data and configured instructions to suggest next best actions, helping users make better decisions without changing screens

Mock Exam 6.q: A developer is building a 'Loan Origination' case type in App Studio. After entering the case type name, Pega GenAI Autopilot suggests a set of relevant data fields and stages. What enables Autopilot to make these specific suggestions?
o: Autopilot interprets the case type name and application context to generate suggestions aligned with common loan origination patterns
Autopilot reads the developer's browser history to understand the intended use case
Autopilot queries the company's existing Pega database to find similar active cases
Autopilot retrieves suggestions from the connected external loan management system
Mock Exam 6.r: Autopilot uses the case type name and the overall application context to understand the intent and apply its AI-trained knowledge of common business patterns (such as loan origination) to suggest relevant fields, stages, and automations

Mock Exam 1.q: Which role serves as the liaison between the client organization and the Pega delivery team, belonging to both the Business and IT teams?
o: Pega Business Architect (BA)
Quality Analyst
Product Owner
Scrum Master
Mock Exam 1.r: The Business Architect (BA) is the liaison who bridges the client organization and the Pega delivery team, and is explicitly a member of both the Business team and the IT team. The Product Owner manages scope/priority; the Scrum Master facilitates ceremonies; Quality Analysts test functionality.

Mock Exam 1.q: A Pega BA diagnoses bottlenecks, workarounds, and root causes in a client's existing process before any redesign begins. Which of the four core BA responsibilities does this describe?
o: Process Design
Analysis
Alignment
Education
Mock Exam 1.r: Diagnosing the existing process — identifying bottlenecks, workarounds, and root causes — is Analysis, the first core responsibility. Process Design optimizes the workflow in Blueprint; Alignment collaborates to build/test; Education teaches OOTB value to stakeholders.

Mock Exam 1.q: What is the primary function of App Studio in Pega Platform?
o: An analytics space for building machine-learning models
A system administration tool for monitoring runtime resources
A low-code authoring space for core Case design, data management, and user experience
An advanced configuration space for complex integrations and security
Mock Exam 1.r: App Studio is the core low-code authoring space used by a wide range of practitioners to build Case Types, manage data, and configure user experiences. Admin Studio handles system administration; Prediction Studio is for ML models; Dev Studio handles advanced configuration.

Mock Exam 1.q: In Pega Platform, a Rule is best described as which of the following?
o: A user interface template only
The basic building block of a Pega application, an instance of a Rule Type that defines behavior without custom coding
A compiled Java class deployed to the server
A database table schema
Mock Exam 1.r: A Rule is the basic building block of a Pega application — an instance of a Rule Type (e.g., a Flow Rule models a Process). Rules define behavior visually without custom coding. Compiled Java, UI templates, and DB schemas are separate concepts.

Mock Exam 1.q: Which TWO of the following are benefits of Pega's Center-out architecture?
o: Agility — a change to central business logic propagates automatically across all channel interfaces
Each channel maintains its own duplicate copy of business logic
Governance — centralized rules simplify auditing and policy enforcement across all interfaces
The data layer must be rebuilt whenever a new channel is added
Mock Exam 1.r: Center-out provides Agility (update central logic once; all channels reflect the change) and Governance (centralized rules simplify auditing/policy enforcement). Duplicating logic per channel is the top-down problem that Center-out solves; the data layer is insulated from channels.

Mock Exam 1.q: A development team needs to work on two features simultaneously without overwriting each other's changes. Which Pega capability isolates each feature's Ruleset changes until they are stable and approved?
o: Access Roles
Branches
Rulesets
Workspaces
Mock Exam 1.r: A Branch is a Ruleset container for rapidly changing records that isolates a feature's changes until stable, conflict-free, and approved. Workspaces are private per-operator scratch spaces; Access Roles govern permissions; Rulesets store Rules but don't inherently isolate parallel work.

Mock Exam 1.q: Which Situational Layer Cake layer should contain components specific to one division, such as a claims-processing flow reused across an insurance division's applications?
o: Application Layer
Implementation Layer
Enterprise Layer
Division Layer
Mock Exam 1.r: The Division Layer holds reusable components specific to a division, shared across that division's applications. Enterprise Layer is organization-wide; Application Layer is app-specific; Implementation Layer handles regional/deployment customization.

Mock Exam 1.q: An architect builds a Decision Table in Dev Studio and wants citizen developers to assemble it in App Studio. What must the architect do to make it available in App Studio?
o: Move it to the Implementation Layer
Copy it manually into each Case Type
Convert it to an Access Role
Mark the Decision Table as a relevant record
Mock Exam 1.r: Marking a rule as a relevant record is the mechanism that makes Dev Studio-built rules available for assembly in App Studio. Manual copying defeats reuse; Access Roles are security constructs; layer placement does not expose rules to the Case Designer.

Mock Exam 1.q: Which inheritance type uses the class-name prefix structure automatically, without any explicit configuration, to determine rule reuse?
o: Multiple inheritance
Pattern inheritance
Ruleset inheritance
Directed inheritance
Mock Exam 1.r: Pattern inheritance is automatic — Pega uses the shared class-name prefix to resolve inheritance with no explicit setup. Directed inheritance explicitly specifies a parent class on the class form and is used to inherit from standard Pega classes outside the naming hierarchy.

Mock Exam 1.q: Which TWO of the following are valid Ruleset naming best practices in Pega Platform?
o: Use cryptic acronyms to keep names short
Include spaces between words for readability
Avoid the 'Pega' or 'Pega-' prefix, which is reserved for Pega internal use
Use descriptive names no longer than 32 characters
Mock Exam 1.r: Best practices: use meaningful descriptive names (≤32 chars) and avoid the reserved 'Pega'/'Pega-' prefix. Spaces and special characters are discouraged, and descriptive names (UPlusTelcoContracts) are preferred over cryptic acronyms (UPTC).

Mock Exam 1.q: At runtime, the Situational Layer Cake assembles the most-specific applicable rule across layers. This capability avoids which two anti-patterns?
o: Continuous Integration AND Continuous Delivery
Using Dev Studio for advanced Rules AND using App Studio for basic Rules
A single monolithic app with complex if-then-else logic AND a sprawl of dozens of near-identical apps
Pattern inheritance AND directed inheritance
Mock Exam 1.r: The Situational Layer Cake dynamically assembles the most-specific rule across layers, avoiding both a single monolithic if-then-else app and the expense of maintaining dozens of near-identical apps for each variation.

Mock Exam 1.q: Pega Deployment Manager provides which capability for managing application changes across environments?
o: A model-driven CI/CD pipeline that automates promotion of changes with approval gates
A standalone SaaS design tool for creating Blueprints
A manual file-copy process for moving Rulesets between servers
An analytics tool for Pega application data
Mock Exam 1.r: Pega Deployment Manager provides a model-driven CI/CD pipeline that automates building, testing, and promoting changes through environment stages (dev → QA → staging → production) with approval gates. Blueprint is the SaaS design tool; BIX handles data extraction.

Mock Exam 1.q: In Pega's Scrum tooling, which tool is a separate, comprehensive application for managing Agile/Scrum backlogs, sprints, teams, and releases at program scale?
o: Agile Studio
Pulse
Agile Workbench
Developer Assistant
Mock Exam 1.r: Agile Studio is the standalone, full-featured Pega application for end-to-end Agile/Scrum management at program scale. Agile Workbench is the lightweight in-App-Studio capture tool; Developer Assistant surfaces guidance during development; Pulse is the collaboration feed.

Mock Exam 1.q: A BA configures two Processes that can be completed in any order, and the Stage should not advance until both finish. How should these be configured?
o: As Alternate Stages
As a single merged Process
As sequential Processes
As parallel Processes
Mock Exam 1.r: Parallel Processes run in any order and both must complete before the Stage advances. Sequential Processes run in a fixed order; Alternate Stages handle exceptions; merging the Processes into one eliminates the independent benefits.

Mock Exam 1.q: A loan application is rejected and must move off the primary path for the applicant to correct information before re-entering the review stage. Which Stage type handles this deviation?
o: Primary Stage
Resolution Stage
Create Stage
Alternate Stage
Mock Exam 1.r: Alternate Stages handle deviations from the primary path — such as rejection for rework — and optionally allow the Case to re-enter the primary path. The Create Stage is the fixed first Stage; Primary Stages lead to expected outcomes; Resolution Stages end the lifecycle.

Mock Exam 1.q: A Case requires sequential sign-off first from a manager and then from a director for large amounts. Which approval pattern does this represent?
o: Single approval
Work Queue routing
Parallel approval
Cascading approval
Mock Exam 1.r: Cascading approval routes the Assignment through multiple sequential approvers in order — often driven by an authority matrix. A single approval needs only one approver; parallel approval is not a standard Pega pattern; Work Queue routing is about team queues, not multi-level sign-off.

Mock Exam 1.q: An SLA has a goal of 2 hours and a deadline of 8 hours. When the goal threshold passes, what happens to Case Urgency?
o: Urgency decreases to signal the work is overdue
The Case is automatically resolved
Nothing happens until the deadline passes
Urgency increases automatically, pushing the Assignment higher in the operator's worklist
Mock Exam 1.r: Case Urgency is a numeric priority that automatically increases as each SLA threshold (goal, then deadline) passes, pushing the Assignment higher in the worklist to signal overdue work. Urgency never decreases automatically; the Case is not auto-resolved at the goal.

Mock Exam 1.q: A Work Queue is most appropriate when an Assignment should:
o: Be routed to one specific named operator
Be automatically resolved without user action
Be sent to the customer for self-service
Be available to any qualified team member to claim and complete
Mock Exam 1.r: A Work Queue is a shared, pull-based pool where any qualified team member can claim and complete the Assignment. A Worklist routes to a specific named operator. Self-service and auto-resolution are different patterns.

Mock Exam 1.q: Which TWO are valid actions that an Automation Step (yellow icon) can perform within a Process Flow?
o: Collect data input from the user
Display a form for the user to fill in
Send an email notification to a stakeholder
Change the Stage of a Case automatically
Mock Exam 1.r: Automation Steps (yellow icons) perform system actions: send emails, create PDFs, wait a specified time, and change Stage automatically. Collecting user input and displaying forms are Collect information Steps (green icons) requiring user interaction.

Mock Exam 1.q: In the Search Duplicate Cases step, which condition type MUST match for a Case to be flagged as a potential duplicate?
o: A weighted condition
No conditions are required
Either a basic or weighted condition
A basic condition
Mock Exam 1.r: Basic conditions are mandatory — they must ALL match. Weighted conditions carry numeric scores; their total must reach a configured threshold. A Case is flagged only when all basic conditions match AND weighted scores meet the threshold.

Mock Exam 1.q: A parent Case must wait for child Cases to reach Resolved-Completed status before continuing. Which Step type accomplishes this?
o: A case-dependency Wait Step
A timer Wait Step
A Change Stage Automation Step
A Collect information Step
Mock Exam 1.r: A case-dependency Wait Step pauses the parent Case until specified child Cases reach a particular status. A timer Wait pauses until a date/time; Change Stage moves to another stage; Collect information requires user input.

Mock Exam 1.q: A When Condition evaluates [Credit Score] [greater than] [700]. Which THREE elements make up this condition structure?
o: Stage, Process, and Step
Basic condition, weighted condition, and threshold
Input value, comparator, and value to compare against
Goal, deadline, and urgency
Mock Exam 1.r: Every When Condition has three parts: an input value (a field or another condition), a comparator (equals, greater than, etc.), and a value to compare against. The other options describe SLA, Case Life Cycle building blocks, or duplicate-detection components.

Mock Exam 1.q: A BA uses a Decision Table to compute a shipping cost. The table evaluates rows from top to bottom. What does it return?
o: The last matching row's result
The result from the first matching row, with an 'otherwise' default if no row matches
An error if no matching row is found
The sum of all matching rows
Mock Exam 1.r: Decision Tables evaluate rows top to bottom and return the result from the first row whose conditions match. An 'otherwise' row provides a default for no-match cases. The table does not sum results or produce errors on no match.

Mock Exam 1.q: Which TWO are business benefits of decomposing a complex process into parent and child Cases?
o: Child Cases require all team members to share one Worklist
Child Cases automatically merge into a single Case at completion
Child Cases can be owned by different teams with independent SLAs
